extracted.intended_audience: general readers, patrons, and comedians seeking information about the Stand Up NY venue
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptive venue-level guidance about how Stand Up NY programs and operates comedy shows, events, and associated media production (show format, schedule, capacity, ticket/package offerings, open-mics, podcast/video labs, and rentals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Showcase format (set length & lineup size)
rubrics_metrics.description: The club offers a showcase format, meaning each of the five to seven comedians performs for 10-20 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the standard performance model for Stand Up NY; individual set lengths (10–20 minutes) and lineup size (5–7 comics) determine show pacing and total runtime.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regular show schedule / frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: The club offers shows seven days a week. A regular week consists of two shows Sunday through Thursday, three shows on Friday, and four shows on Saturday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the venue's programming density and typical nightly capacity for bookings; special events may deviate from this pattern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open-mic schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Up New York hosts open-mics every weekday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open-mics provide opportunities for local/aspiring comedians to perform; they are a regular feature distinct from showcase nights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue capacity and seating/layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Original roomy, 110-seat space composed of both a bar and showroom; after relocation, shows are now performed in a 120-seat showroom above the dining area at Bond 45.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seating capacity and layout affect show format, ticketing, and live-audience experience; some special events have much more limited seating (example: 20 seats for a March 26, 2025 show).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dinner-and-show partnership / ticket package
rubrics_metrics.description: Relocated to Bond 45 and partnered with the restaurant to offer a dinner-and-show experience. The club offers an $85 package including a three-course meal, show, tax, and tip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This pricing/experience model bundles dining and performance; partnership affects venue logistics (shows above dining area) and value proposition for patrons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stand Up NY Labs (podcast and video production)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Up NY Labs: a place where free comedy podcasts and videos are produced featuring comedians affiliated with Stand-Up NY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Labs recorded podcasts (examples: 'Tuesdays with Stories', 'Charlie Murphy Presents', 'We Know Nothing', 'Race Wars', 'My Sexy Podcast', 'Invasion of Privacy'). The Labs were located above the original club; current status at the Bond 45 location was noted as unclear as of March 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special events and alternative-venue tapings
rubrics_metrics.description: The club runs special events such as 'Lunchtime Laughs,' a 45-minute live stand-up taping streamed on Zeam Studio’s Big Apple Live channel, which may occur at alternate venues (e.g., Zeam Studios) with limited seating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special-event formats (shorter runtimes, streamed tapings, alternate locations) differ from regular showcase nights and often have restricted audience size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private event rental availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Up NY rents out the venue for private events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venue rental is an alternative use case for the space and may impose different requirements for scheduling, capacity, and setup compared to public shows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lineup diversity and mix of performers
rubrics_metrics.description: Known for featuring diverse lineups of well-known and local comedians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The venue programming emphasizes a mixture of established and local talent; historical performers listed (e.g., Chris Rock, Jerry Seinfeld, Jon Stewart, Louis C.K., Amy Schumer) illustrate the calibre and diversity of acts the club books.
